title: Note sort response
description: POST /v1/notes/sort. Template fields found in the notes, for the investor to check before screening. Only facts true on the founding date become fields; anything later (traction, funding, hires) is listed in kept_out and stays in the notes, which never reach the model. Names are never put into fields.

fields.description: Only the fields the notes state; a field left out means the notes don't say. Education and jobs are left to the research agent: a partial list from a note would replace its fuller one.

founder.description: The founder's and company's names, if the notes give them. For the research agent only: never part of the profile the model reads.

founding_date.description: The founding date, if the notes give it; otherwise null.

evidence.description: The words in the notes behind each value, so the investor can see why it was filled.

kept_out.description: Short descriptions of facts in the notes that were not used for fields, mostly because they happened after the founding date (e.g. 'raised a seed round').

sorter.description: 'claude' for the real sorter; 'mock' for the keyword-matching stand-in used in tests and local demos.
